catalyst_rows.raw_text: Vivos submitted IDE application to the FDA for authority to initiate human clinical trials. Filing was an amendment, addressing 63 FDA comments from previous applications and marks first filing following grant of FDA Breakthrough Device Designation for the RadioGel Precision Radionuclide Therapy.

Vivos reports encouraging human clinical trial results and announces expansion plans. Detailed assessment of available data from patients will be presented to the Ethics Committee; results will be shared with the FDA to further support RadioGel development.
